**Current**
- Bona has a foot sprain and has not played in the preseason. Yahoo lists him as questionable (foot). (fact, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/KqTKVExQGLo?t=1409), [10-06](https://youtu.be/eTsjuVu1trk?t=136), [10-06](https://youtu.be/eTsjuVu1trk?t=121))
- He is projected as the 76ers' backup center behind Joel Embiid. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/KqTKVExQGLo?t=1409))
- Philadelphia has very few backup bigs. Hukporti is out for the season and Tacko Fall is injured. The bench is weak overall. (fact, 2026-10-13; [10-06](https://youtu.be/eTsjuVu1trk?t=121), [08-06](https://youtu.be/gTsfR5PxAMY?t=1851), [10-13](https://youtu.be/KqTKVExQGLo?t=1509))
- It is an open question whether LeBron James will play small-ball center. That could take backup center minutes away from Bona. (fact, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/KqTKVExQGLo?t=234))
- He is worth stashing as Embiid's injury replacement. Experts expect Embiid to miss games, and Bona would likely take his minutes. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/KqTKVExQGLo?t=1409), [10-06](https://youtu.be/eTsjuVu1trk?t=136), [09-17](https://youtu.be/ahNxsoU8Hx4?t=1654))
- With a March 28 end, the 76ers play 3, 4 and 4 games in the fantasy playoff weeks. They have only 13 back-to-backs all season. (fact, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/KqTKVExQGLo?t=1680), [08-16](https://youtu.be/gf_6GveiAls?t=1148))

**Durable**
- He makes no threes. (fact, 2026-10-16; stats)
- His blocks, field goal percentage and free throw percentage are useful even in small minutes. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [10-13](https://youtu.be/KqTKVExQGLo?t=1400))
- Nick Nurse plays his starters very heavy minutes, which limits minutes for backups like Bona when the starters are healthy. (fact, 2026-09-09; [08-06](https://youtu.be/gTsfR5PxAMY?t=556), [09-09](https://youtu.be/7BllEsdNLoM?t=1956))
- He has a very high foul rate per 36 minutes. (fact, 2026-08-06; [08-06](https://youtu.be/gTsfR5PxAMY?t=1861))
- His rebounding is not strong for a center. (fact, 2026-08-06; [08-06](https://youtu.be/gTsfR5PxAMY?t=1861), stats)

**Tags**
- Current: `handcuff` (Backup center behind Joel Embiid), `injured now` (Foot sprain, has missed the preseason), `questionable` (Yahoo status Q (foot)), `waiver watch` (Pick him up if Embiid misses time), `thin rotation` (Thin backup center group: Hukporti out for the season, Tacko Fall injured), `few back-to-backs` (13 back-to-backs)
- Durable: `foul prone` (Very high foul rate per 36 minutes), `no 3PM`, `heavy starter minutes` (Nick Nurse)

**Note.** Bona is ranked 286 on Yahoo and 265 on ESPN, both sites price him at 0 USD, and he went for 3 USD in our league last season, so he is outside our 144-player draft pool. He plays about 17 minutes a game, and his value is limited to blocks (1.3 per game), FG% and low turnovers. That only matters if Embiid misses time, so leave him on waivers at the draft. Early in the season, check whether his foot sprain has healed and whether LeBron takes the backup center minutes, then add him quickly when Embiid sits.
